A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus & Rice** (≈30 min):

1. Season chicken thighs/breasts with salt, pepper, paprika.
2. Sear skin-side down in oven-safe skillet (2 min), flip, add minced garlic, lemon slices, asparagus.
3. Pour in ½ cup chicken broth + 1 tbsp butter, roast at 425°F (220°C) 15–20 min until chicken hits 165°F.
4. Serve over 90-sec microwave rice; drizzle pan sauce.
